anchor.semantic_hook: The literal question of who an unexpected person is becomes visible through an identity-checking threshold that never fully reveals its visitor.
anchor.setting: A compact inquiry chamber contains a closed apartment door, a plain desk, a wall telephone, a photograph easel, and a small performance platform. The sole surreal feature is a colossal freestanding keyhole suspended in the center of the chamber, framing only a narrow partial view of the chamber's far side. Movable domestic and performance props surround the same threshold.

variations.scene_adjust: an unmarked photograph of a shadowy man, an open photo envelope, and a dark overcoat

variations.scene_adjust: an unmarked microphone, a guitar, scattered fan flowers, and a small stack of blank record sleeves

anchor.semantic_hook: Pointing the finger is staged literally by directing an extended index finger at the person or object receiving blame.
